page_title: ACM 3-0 LEC | AC Milan v Lecce 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.

89' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Mike Maignan was alert and the score remains the same. Lecce force a corner. They send men into the box.
85' Luca Gotti decides to make a substitution. Patrick Dorgu will be replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
84' A shot from the edge of the box by Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is a waste and goes well wide of the right post.
84' AC Milan take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Substitution. Theo Hernandez makes his way off the pitch and Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) comes on as his replacement.
78' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
78' Stefano Pioli prepares a substitution. Tijjani Reijnders is replaced by Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan).
78' That will be all from Alexis Blin who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Medon Berisha (Lecce).
73' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) will replace Lorenzo Venuti.
69' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
68' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Wladimiro Falcone.
67' Alexis Blin (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Luca Massimi saw the whole situation. It's a free kick to AC Milan in a dangerous position.
65' Crossbar! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
62' A substitution has been made. Olivier Giroud is replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
62' Stefano Pioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yunus Musah (AC Milan) replacing Christian Pulisic.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Gabbia departs the field of play to be replaced by Simon Kjaer (AC Milan).
58' 3 - 0 Goal! Yacine Adli produces a great pass that finds Rafael Leao (AC Milan) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a low shot into the back of the net. 3:0.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AC Milan.

55' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. AC Milan will take a corner kick.
55' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Wladimiro Falcone punches the ball away.
50' Luca Massimi interrupts the game. One of the players from Lecce won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
46' Half-time substitution. Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) will not participate anymore and Roberto Piccoli is coming on.
46' Luca Gotti makes a half-time substitution. Pontus Almqvist comes on in place of Lameck Banda (Lecce).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) meets a cross inside the box, but Wladimiro Falcone wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
45+1' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
42' A snap shot by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan produces a good save to thwart him.
39' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lecce, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
37' Luca Massimi blows for a foul after Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
34' Alexis Blin (Lecce) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
31' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
29' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
27' Lameck Banda (Lecce) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) creates some space to meet a good cross and shoots the ball at goal, but his attempt is perfectly claimed by the goalkeeper.
24' Dangerous play by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan). Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Alexis Blin (Lecce) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.

20' 2 - 0 Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:0.
19' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
19' An attempted cross from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is cleared. AC Milan get a corner.

19' AC Milan are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
18' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) commits a rough foul. Luca Massimi stops the game and makes a call.
16' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
12' Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) receives an accurate pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is prepared and denies his low, long-range blast aimed directly at the bottom of the net.
11' AC Milan failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

11' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
10' AC Milan quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
9' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. AC Milan win a corner.

8' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
6' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the left post. Samuel Chukwueze provided an assist for the goal.
6' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Yacine Adli (AC Milan), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
5' Lameck Banda (Lecce) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Massimi blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to AC Milan.
3' Wasted opportunity. Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
2' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Luca Massimi.
